author: ParleSprint Editorial
title: A clinic message
summary: Catch an appointment time, read a clinic notice, and ask for an appointment.

lesson.title: Clinic appointment
lesson.subtitle: Listening, reading, then a useful phrase

steps.fr: Votre rendez-vous est à dix heures.
steps.question: What time is the appointment?
steps.explain: The recording says dix heures, which means 10:00.

steps.prompt: Read the clinic notice. When is this clinic open?
steps.promptFr: CLINIQUE SANS RENDEZ-VOUS · Lundi au vendredi · 8 h à 16 h
options: Monday to Friday, 8 a.m. to 4 p.m.
Saturday and Sunday, 8 a.m. to noon
steps.explain: The notice gives weekdays from 8 h to 16 h.

steps.tip: Say this to ask a clinic receptionist for an appointment.
